text:
maya (Design): Quick note: testing compact left nav that groups Models + Deployments. Label options: 'Workloads' vs 'Workspaces'?
sam (Frontend): 'Workloads' is explicit; 'Workspaces' is friendly. Breadcrumbs must match the label.

jonah (PM): Need canonical paths. Option A: /w/:orgId/workloads/:type/:id. Option B: /workspace/:id/model/:modelId. Which is cleaner?
sam (Frontend): Prefer /workspace/:id/model/:modelId for router simplicity. Fallback: missing modelId -> list view; invalid workspace -> redirect to /workspace with toast.

kevin (A11y): A11y points: add aria-current on last breadcrumb; separators aria-hidden. Skiplink text: 'Skip to main navigation'. When nav collapses, ensure skip target is first interactive nav item.

maya (Design): Swap + for chevron with tooltip "Expand". Make whole row clickable for mobile.
sam (Frontend): Will implement button with aria-expanded and aria-controls and 44px touch target. Also add ?navMode=compact override for demos. Router should preserve ?view=compact query param for permalinks.

jonah (PM): Support asked that permalinks preserve view state, so use query param not cookie.

kevin (A11y): Announce view changes via aria-live polite region (e.g., 'Navigation collapsed'). Use aria-label on truncated breadcrumbs rather than title. After breadcrumb navigation, focus main header (tabindex=-1).

maya (Design): Poll: icons-only compact vs icons+mini-label. I'll run hallway test. nav-compact-experiments branch deployed to staging: staging.redwood.internal/nav-test (build 2026.03.22-9). Action items: validate skiplink, aria-live, breadcrumb contrast, permalink behavior.
sam (Frontend): Will test and report fixes.

kevin (A11y): I'll do SR pass and post notes.

maya (Design): If no objection by EOD Friday we'll ship 'Workloads' with the a11y fixes. :sparkles:
